scenes.title: Bernard Baars demonstrating the Global Workspace blackboard/stage diagram beside a binocular-rivalry stereoscope
scenes.era: 1988-2005, San Diego cognitive neuroscience seminar laboratory

layout.description: Sunlit academic neuroscience room featuring a brass-and-optical table stereoscope feeding a 'House' card to the left eye and 'Face' card to the right eye, alongside a large crisp architectural diagram of the 'Global Workspace' showing one bright central bulletin board connected by clean lines to 'Language', 'Episodic Memory', 'Motor', and 'Visual' desks.

positions.where: peering into the twin-lens tabletop stereoscope pressing left button for '100% House' then right button for '100% Face' — never both mixed

positions.who: Bernard Baars (mannequin in blazer and glasses)
positions.where: standing beside the Global Workspace schematic pointing to the single central broadcast hub linking isolated specialist desks

props.name: tabletop twin-card binocular rivalry stereoscope
props.period_detail: optical divider presenting a crisp line-drawn House to the left eye and a Face to the right eye simultaneously
props.physical_behavior: proves both retinas get input continuously while conscious broadcast allows only ONE winner on stage

props.name: Global Workspace architectural board
props.period_detail: clean museum-grade schematic showing one central 'Broadcast Stage' radiating clean lines to silent specialist modules
props.physical_behavior: illustrates why serial bottleneck buys parallel teamwork

props.name: alternating winner-take-all toggle strip
props.period_detail: chart showing clean square-wave flips between 'FACE ONLY' and 'HOUSE ONLY'

actions.verb_sequence: looks through the stereoscope at both cards simultaneously -> presses 'Face' key -> three seconds later switches cleanly to 'House' key as the conscious winner flips
traces the winning 'Face' card jumping from isolated visual input onto the central Global Broadcast board

reactions.reaction: steps back amazed that two wide-open eyes still yield only one conscious scene at a time
points out how one shared microphone lets forty silent brain systems collaborate on novel problems

scenes.wardrobe: Clean academic attire: tailored navy blazer over light blue shirt on Baars; knit sweater and slacks on observer.
scenes.recognition_hook: Show a house to your left eye and a face to your right eye at once — both eyes fire nonstop, yet only ONE winner gets the brain's global loudspeaker at a time.

key_visual.description: a cognitive neuroscientist beside a 'Global Workspace' broadcast diagram while a participant looks into a two-card 'House vs Face' tabletop stereoscope

scenes.title: AI 'Blackboard' inspiration: six silent specialists reading one shared board

layout.description: Bright round seminar room where six specialist mannequins (labeled 'Syntax', 'Memory', 'Motor', 'Vision') sit silently at separate desks until ONE problem card is posted on the central whiteboard.

positions.where: looking up simultaneously the instant one card is pinned on the center whiteboard, raising one matching solution card

props.name: central shared 'WANTED: Word Starting With A...' card
props.physical_behavior: one unconscious specialist desk holds up 'ARCHIMEDES'

actions.verb_sequence: pins 'Greek bathtub Eureka scientist?' on center board -> Memory desk raises 'Archimedes!' card

reactions.reaction: solves together what no isolated desk could solve alone

scenes.recognition_hook: Like engineers sharing one central whiteboard, consciousness broadcasts a question to modules you don't even know you have.

scenes.title: Podcast + Email collision on the single serial stage

layout.description: Sunlit desk where a worker wearing headphones tries typing an email while a spoken podcast plays — then rewinds the podcast realizing zero words registered for two minutes.

positions.where: pausing headphones with a rueful smile after missing the entire spoken paragraph while writing

props.name: rewound audio progress bar
props.period_detail: visual proof that only one verbal coalition held the workspace

actions.verb_sequence: types three sentences -> realizes podcast vanished from awareness -> hits pause to finish writing cleanly

scenes.recognition_hook: Two voices grabbing one PA microphone at once just make static — your Global Workspace only broadcasts one.

scenes.title: Posting one clear problem before a quiet walk lets the auditorium answer

layout.description: Clean desk where an engineer writes ONE crisp bottleneck question on an index card, steps outside into sunlit air, and has the solution click into place.

positions.where: writing one clear question card, then pausing mid-stroll with a sudden flash of clarity

props.name: single-question index card
props.period_detail: loads a crisp query onto the workspace before stepping back

actions.verb_sequence: defines the exact puzzle clearly -> steps away from screen clutter -> jots down the insight that surfaces

reactions.reaction: nods gratefully as background modules deliver

scenes.recognition_hook: Load one crystal-clear question onto your conscious stage, then stop crowding the microphone so your unconscious experts can answer.
